0022600198.text: The Utah Jazz (1-8, 0-4 on the road, on a seven-game losing streak) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (7-3, winners of three straight) in the 10th game of the Jazz's season. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Lauri Markkanen is day-to-day with a wrist sprain and is a game-time decision, while Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery), and Joan Beringer is day-to-day with a fracture and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Jazz lost their 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 147-111 loss in Minneapolis on March 18, 2026.
